speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
text: asked	the Minister for Health what efforts have been taken to reach out to and include persons with disabilities and/or special needs in past and ongoing health and screening campaigns.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
text: The Ministry takes an inclusive approach in the implementation of health promotion and disease prevention programmes and campaigns for the population.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Such programmes also cater to persons with disabilities and special needs.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
text: The HPB works closely with the doctors, dentists, parents and staff of the special schools to ensure that these services are delivered in a manner that is appropriate for the students.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Similarly, Response, Early intervention and Assessment in Community mental Health (REACH) teams cover both mainstream schools and special needs schools.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
text: REACH teams work with special needs schools to help students with psychological, emotional and behavioural problems.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
text: They also provide training and support to allied health staff of special needs schools to strengthen their ability to identify, manage and, if necessary, refer at-risk children to the team for intervention.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Health screening is also available in locations such as polyclinics and community centres, which are easily accessible for people with disabilities and their caregivers.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
text: In addition, health promotion and education programmes that aim to foster healthy lifestyle habits, including healthy eating and physical activities, target all Singaporeans.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
text: We recognise that persons with disabilities and special needs are a diverse group, with a wide range of disabilities and functional capabilities, and possibly a variety of underlying medical conditions.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Some may also require customised preventive health advice, health screening and care, which are best done by their family physicians.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Nevertheless, we will continue to review and finetune our health education and promotion initiatives to meet the needs of our population, including those with disabilities or special needs.

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
text: The basis for my Parliamentary Question is to find out what are the specific efforts that have been carried out to reach out to persons with disabilities or special needs, with regard to common illnesses that the community faces.

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
text: Two supplementary questions: first, does the Ministry consider having specific campaigns to target persons with disabilities and special needs, regarding information on common illnesses and prevention?

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
text: The reason is because I believe that there may be higher chances that, for such people, especially in certain families, it is quite likely that the illnesses may go undiagnosed for longer periods of time than for normal people.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: It will include people with disabilities or special needs.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: They will also be sent to the people with disabilities and special needs.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: In many instances, they will probably be able to respond to the letters.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: As I have said, people with disabilities and special needs are a diverse group, with a wide range of disabilities and functional capabilities.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: So, for some, the caregivers may be able to respond and bring them for health screening.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: In addition to that, as I have said, our programmes and campaigns are inclusive.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: So, as I have said, we will bear in mind that even as we review and finetune our health promotion and educational programmes, it will be to meet the needs of the population, including people with disabilities and special needs.
